autoclub.name: Auto Club Speedway (Fontana)
autoclub.description: Auto Club Speedway in Fontana, California - the 2-mile D-oval, in its own spot in the track list. Races for every series: Cup 'California 400', O'Reilly 'Inland Empire 300', Truck 'Fontana 200' and ARCA 'Fontana 150'. Use Career races to put it into your career.
credits: vhr_auto-club-speedway v2.1: VHR StockCar Ovals by Rainmaker (from CorvetteDave's rFactor track)

freecam.name: Free Cam
freecam.description: Free camera in races and replays. F5 = free cam with the race frozen (in a replay: the replay is held where you are), F6 = free cam with the race running, I/J/K/L = look; press the same key again to go back. All on-screen UI is hidden while the free cam is on and comes back when you turn it off, and the replay's own controls don't react while you fly around.

mexico.name: Mexico City - Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez (NASCAR layout)
mexico.description: ACU's acu_mexico_2021 with our NASCAR link-road layout, in its own menu slot (Track_Mexico). Cup, O'Reilly, Truck and ARCA events, own logos, pits, AI targets and baseline setups.
